howto.goal: Townsfolk: vote out both mafia. Mafia: survive until the town is outnumbered.
howto.setup: Six seats: two mafia, a doctor, a detective and two townsfolk. Day and night alternate.

sections.title: Night
sections.text: The mafia pick a victim. The doctor may save one person, and the detective may check one person's side.

sections.title: Day
sections.text: Everyone talks, then votes by clicking a player's name. The most votes is removed from the town.

sections.title: Winning
sections.text: The town wins when both mafia are out. The mafia win when they equal or outnumber the town.

controls: Click a player's name to vote for that person.
Talk in the table chat — the whole town reads it.

frames.say: Six seats, two of them mafia.

demo.intro: One day and one night, played out.

frames.say: Six people sit down. Two are mafia, and only they know who.
Night falls. The mafia choose a victim.
Day comes. Everyone argues about who stayed too quiet.
The town votes. One person is removed.
If both mafia are gone, the town wins.

demo.outro: Say something every day. Silence is what gets people voted out.

steps.say: Read the night result, then say what you noticed in chat.
Click a player's name to vote.
If you are the detective, share your checks carefully — the mafia hear them too.
Count the seats: when the mafia match the town, they win.
